## Mission staffing, equipment and procurement

Caucasus correspondence concerns personnel, equipment, cargo and procurement. Market reports, appointments and suspension of manganese purchases record different decisions within the mission’s work.

| Subject | Summary | Page editions |
|---|---|---|
| **October correspondence with the Caucasus** | Messages concern administrative reinforcement, purchasing and prices, electrical equipment, Violetta cargo for Poti, radio arrangements and liaison with Tiflis. | [p. 68](../cases/pages/068.md#source-p68-a1) · [p. 69](../cases/pages/069.md#source-p69-a) · [p. 70](../cases/pages/070.md#source-p70-a1) · [p. 71](../cases/pages/071.md#source-p71-a1) · [p. 72](../cases/pages/072.md#source-p72-a1) |
| **Officer replacements and manganese purchases** | Officer-reassignment messages name a Bavarian cavalry-brigade appointment and a replacement for the Caucasus delegation. A separate instruction suspends further manganese purchases. | [p. 66](../cases/pages/066.md#source-p66-c1) · [p. 67](../cases/pages/067.md#source-p67-a2) |
| **Market intelligence and an inspector request** | Westernhagen is urged to return with local market information before buying begins. Another fragment concerns an inspector request with Kress’s agreement. | [p. 63](../cases/pages/063.md#source-p63-a) · [p. 65](../cases/pages/065.md#source-p65-a) |

## Representation, Poti traffic and withdrawal

The Tiflis appointment concerns Polish representation. Separate Poti and armistice messages document transport-related communication and withdrawal instructions; their source editions retain damaged passages and differences between receptions.

| Subject | Summary | Page editions |
|---|---|---|
| **Polish representation in Tiflis** | The Polish Foreign Ministry appoints Waclaw von Ostrowski representative for Georgia, Armenia and Azerbaijan, based in Tiflis; the courier identification remains conditional. | [p. 192](../cases/pages/192.md#source-p192-2) · [p. 199](../cases/pages/199.md#source-p199-b1) |
| **Poti horse shipment and handover** | The partly reconstructed opening concerns horses aboard steamers toward Poti. The later parts concern a cavalry-brigade shipment, a fragmentary horse-handover passage and an urgent request for a reply. | [p. 59](../cases/pages/059.md#source-p59-a1) |
| **Allied conditions for withdrawal and the Tiflis guard** | Parallel receptions explain that Allied assessment of local conditions governs withdrawal from former Russian territory; no demand to remove the Tiflis guard had yet been received. | [p. 212](../cases/pages/212.md#source-p212-a2) · [p. 218](../cases/pages/218.md#source-p218-a1) |
